st-ga-dist-north-goa.description: District of Goa (state), India, headquartered at Panaji. Population approximately 817,761 (2011 census), area approximately 1,736 km2.

st-ga-dist-south-goa.name: South Goa
st-ga-dist-south-goa.description: District of Goa (state), India, headquartered at Margao. Population approximately 639,962 (2011 census), area approximately 1,966 km2.

st-ga-dist-kushavati.name: Kushavati
st-ga-dist-kushavati.description: District of Goa (state), India, headquartered at Quepem. Population approximately 220,000 (2011 census), area approximately 1,962 km2.

st-ga-gram-panchayats.name: Gram Panchayats of Goa
st-ga-gram-panchayats.description: The village-level tier of Panchayati Raj Institutions in Goa, directly elected under Part IX of the Constitution.
st-ga-gram-panchayats.legalBasis: Constitution of India, Part IX (73rd Amendment, 1992)
st-ga-gram-panchayats.notes: State-wise seat/panchayat count could not be sourced in this research pass: lgdirectory.gov.in's per-state query reports (globalViewStatewiseLocalBody.do and the Download Directory PRI reports) require solving a CAPTCHA to retrieve data, which is outside permitted tooling; only the LGD homepage's national totals (see Local Government of India (aggregate)) were accessible without one. No alternate state-wise secondary source was found before the session's web-search budget was exhausted.

st-ga-panchayat-samitis.name: Panchayat Samitis of Goa
st-ga-panchayat-samitis.description: The intermediate (block) tier of Panchayati Raj Institutions in Goa, directly elected under Part IX of the Constitution.
st-ga-panchayat-samitis.legalBasis: Constitution of India, Part IX (73rd Amendment, 1992)
st-ga-panchayat-samitis.notes: State-wise count not sourced; see st-<code>-gram-panchayats notes for why (LGD per-state reports are CAPTCHA-gated).

st-ga-zila-parishads.name: Zila Parishads of Goa
st-ga-zila-parishads.description: The district-level tier of Panchayati Raj Institutions in Goa, directly elected under Part IX of the Constitution.
st-ga-zila-parishads.legalBasis: Constitution of India, Part IX (73rd Amendment, 1992)
st-ga-zila-parishads.notes: State-wise count not sourced; see st-<code>-gram-panchayats notes for why (LGD per-state reports are CAPTCHA-gated). Typically one Zila Parishad per district, so the count should be close to (but need not exactly equal) the district count.

st-ga-urban-local-bodies.name: Urban Local Bodies of Goa
st-ga-urban-local-bodies.description: The urban local self-government bodies of Goa (municipal corporations, municipalities/municipal councils and nagar/town panchayats), constituted under Part IXA of the Constitution.
st-ga-urban-local-bodies.legalBasis: Constitution of India, Part IXA (74th Amendment, 1992)
st-ga-urban-local-bodies.notes: Only the municipal-corporation count is directly sourced (Wikipedia 'List of municipal corporations in India', cross-validated against the national total of 273 on lgdirectory.gov.in's dashboard). Municipality/nagar-panchayat (municipal council / nagar panchayat) counts per state were not obtainable without the CAPTCHA-gated LGD per-state reports or an additional secondary source, and are left out rather than estimated.

st-ga-dept-home.name: Home Department
st-ga-dept-home.description: Runs the Goa Police, prisons, fire and emergency services and internal security.

st-ga-dept-finance.name: Department of Finance
st-ga-dept-finance.description: Prepares the state budget, manages treasury, debt and expenditure, and releases funds to every other department.
st-ga-dept-finance.head: st-ga-pos-chief-minister

st-ga-dept-vigilance.name: Vigilance Department
st-ga-dept-vigilance.description: Investigates corruption complaints against state government employees and departments.

st-ga-dept-official-language.name: Department of Official Language

st-ga-dept-official-language.head: st-ga-pos-chief-minister

st-ga-dept-personnel.name: Department of Personnel
st-ga-dept-personnel.description: Handles recruitment rules, service matters and cadre management of Goa government employees.
st-ga-dept-personnel.head: st-ga-pos-chief-minister

st-ga-dept-health.name: Department of Health
st-ga-dept-health.description: Runs Goa Medical College and the state's government hospitals, health centres and public-health programmes.
st-ga-dept-health.head: st-ga-pos-minister-1

st-ga-dept-urban-development.name: Department of Urban Development
st-ga-dept-urban-development.description: Oversees municipal councils and corporations and urban infrastructure and sanitation projects.
st-ga-dept-urban-development.head: st-ga-pos-minister-1

st-ga-dept-town-and-country-planning.name: Town and Country Planning Department
st-ga-dept-town-and-country-planning.description: Prepares regional and outline development plans and regulates land-use conversion and construction across Goa.
st-ga-dept-town-and-country-planning.head: st-ga-pos-minister-1

st-ga-dept-women-and-child-development.name: Directorate of Women and Child Development
st-ga-dept-women-and-child-development.description: Runs anganwadis, child nutrition schemes and women's safety and welfare programmes in Goa.
st-ga-dept-women-and-child-development.head: st-ga-pos-minister-1

st-ga-dept-forest.name: Forest Department
st-ga-dept-forest.description: Manages Goa's forests and wildlife sanctuaries and enforces forest and wildlife protection laws.
st-ga-dept-forest.head: st-ga-pos-minister-1

st-ga-dept-water-resources.name: Department of Water Resources
st-ga-dept-water-resources.description: Builds irrigation infrastructure and manages Goa's rivers and water-resource projects.
st-ga-dept-water-resources.head: st-ga-pos-minister-2

st-ga-dept-cooperation.name: Department of Cooperation
aliases: Office of the Registrar of Cooperative Societies

st-ga-dept-cooperation.head: st-ga-pos-minister-2

st-ga-dept-provedoria.name: Provedoria de Assistência Pública
st-ga-dept-provedoria.description: A Portuguese-era public charitable institution, unique to Goa, that runs orphanages, old-age homes and welfare shelters.
st-ga-dept-provedoria.head: st-ga-pos-minister-2

st-ga-dept-transport.name: Directorate of Transport

st-ga-dept-transport.head: st-ga-pos-minister-3

st-ga-dept-industries.name: Department of Industries

st-ga-dept-industries.head: st-ga-pos-minister-3

st-ga-dept-panchayati-raj.name: Directorate of Panchayats

st-ga-dept-panchayati-raj.head: st-ga-pos-minister-3

st-ga-dept-protocol-and-hospitality.name: Protocol and Hospitality Department
st-ga-dept-protocol-and-hospitality.description: Arranges state protocol for VIP visits, ceremonial functions and precedence at government events.
st-ga-dept-protocol-and-hospitality.head: st-ga-pos-minister-3

st-ga-dept-tourism.name: Department of Tourism
st-ga-dept-tourism.description: Promotes Goa's beaches, heritage and festivals and regulates the state's large tourism and hospitality industry.
st-ga-dept-tourism.head: st-ga-pos-minister-4

st-ga-dept-information-technology.name: Department of Information Technology, Electronics and Communications

st-ga-dept-information-technology.head: st-ga-pos-minister-4

st-ga-dept-printing-and-stationery.name: Department of Printing and Stationery

st-ga-dept-revenue.name: Revenue Department

st-ga-dept-revenue.head: st-ga-pos-minister-5

st-ga-dept-labour.name: Labour Department

st-ga-dept-river-navigation.name: River Navigation Department

st-ga-dept-drinking-water.name: Department of Drinking Water

st-ga-dept-electricity.name: Electricity Department

st-ga-dept-art-and-culture.name: Directorate of Art and Culture

st-ga-dept-sports-and-youth-affairs.name: Directorate of Sports and Youth Affairs
